newsitem.title: FRANCE: Metaleurop plans 600 mln Ffr cap rise.
newsitem.headline: Metaleurop plans 600 mln Ffr cap rise.

text.p: Metaleurop, a unit of Germany's Preussag AG, said in a statement it planned a capital increase of around 600 million francs shortly.
The increase will be through the issue of equity warrants.
Each new share will carry one warrant, while two warrants will entitle the holder to one Metaleurop share.

It said its two main shareholders, Preussag and Swiss commodity trading firm Glencore, had already said they planned to subscribe to the capital increase up to the level of their respective shareholdings.
Glencore last month increased its stake in Metaleurop to 25.4 percent. Preussag holds the same share but has double voting rights.
